newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, France sign air force technical deal.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, France sign air force technical deal.

text.p: Singapore and France have signed an agreement allowing the city state's air force to use French air bases for training, the Singapore Defence Ministry said on Friday.
The agreement was signed on Monday by General Jean Rannou, the French Air Force Chief of Staff, and Major General Goh Yong Siang, Singapore's Air Force chief, the Ministry said in a statement.
It said Singapore "pilots will receive more effective training and their interactions with their French counterparts will be mutually beneficial".

Under programmes agreed earlier, the two sides may exchange personnel and Singapore air force members attend courses conducted by the French, observe their exercises, and receive helicopter training from them.
